calculation.description: Two-day contrarian return scaled by ten-day volatility, strengthened by a three-session smoothed positive abnormal log-volume shock. All inputs use data available through the decision date prior close.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.062435, 530 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.044864, 350 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.039247, 449 dates). Smoothing reduced turnover versus the unsmoothed variant while retaining admission-gate performance; low coverage reflects volume availability across the deliberately small cross-asset universe.
